home.title:
Numbers,
made tangible.
home.lead: A traditional Chinese abacus. Two upper beads, five lower beads.
home.body: Move 3D beads, explore place values and practise four arithmetic games.
home.countBody: Only beads resting against the beam count.
home.ruleTen: The next rod to the left is worth ten times as much.
home.gameBody: Watch the beads move, then work through each challenge yourself.
home.imageAlt: Actual SuanCraft 3D abacus showing 987654321, with two upper and five lower beads per rod.
help.title: Help & support
help.lead: Move the beads, understand the number, then choose a game.
help.quickTitle: Move a bead toward the beam.
help.quickBody: Drag along its rod. Neighboring beads move together when they meet; the frame and beam limit their travel. Use one-rod practice for larger targets. iPhone uses landscape; iPad and Mac adapt to the window. On visionOS, look at a bead, pinch and move along its rod.
help.readBody: Lower beads count as one; upper beads count as five. Only the connected group against the beam counts. The rightmost rod is ones, then tens, hundreds and so on to the left. A traditional two-upper, five-lower rod can temporarily hold more than nine: carry manually. Open Beads & numbers to see each place’s contribution.
help.gameBody: Open the gamepad menu to choose a game. Watch, pause, continue or step through a demonstration, then practise and check your bead positions. Leaving restores your free-play abacus.
help.voiceBody: Enable Lesson narration in the introduction or View menu. Only essential arithmetic chants are spoken; explanations stay on screen. Voices depend on those installed on your device. On iPhone, enabled narration can play in Silent mode; check media volume and the audio output. Bead sound effects have a separate switch.
help.troubleBody: Manual bead editing is locked during the demonstration, even when paused. Choose practice or leave the game to move beads yourself. Use Reset view if the model is hard to see. If a matching system voice is unavailable, captions remain visible. Bead positions and lesson progress last only for the current window session; the narration preference is stored locally.
help.contactBody: Email us with your app version, device, OS version and steps to reproduce the problem. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information. You can also report a bug on GitHub; GitHub reports are public.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What stays on your device, and what happens when you visit this site or contact us.
privacy.appBody: SuanCraft does not send your bead positions or lesson progress to the developer. The App has no accounts, advertising or third-party analytics SDKs. Bead positions and progress remain in memory for the current window session. Your narration preference is saved locally on your device.
privacy.voiceBody: Lesson narration uses Apple’s system text-to-speech and available installed voices. SuanCraft does not request microphone access or record your voice. Apple manages system voices, downloads and platform services under its own policies. TestFlight testing and diagnostics are also handled by Apple.
privacy.webBody: Cloudflare hosts and delivers this site. For delivery and security it may process technical request data such as IP address, browser information, requested URL and time. We do not add advertising trackers or a separate analytics script. Language selection is encoded in the URL, not a tracking cookie. Cloudflare may use necessary security cookies when its protections apply.
privacy.supportBody: If you email support, your email address and the information you choose to send are used to answer your request. Email service providers process that correspondence. Please avoid sensitive personal data. You may ask us about information you have sent or request deletion when it is no longer needed. GitHub issue reports are public and subject to GitHub’s policies.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact the developer at the email below. We will update this page if these practices change. The date above identifies the current policy.
error.title: Page not found
error.body: The page may have moved. Return to SuanCraft or open the guide.
help.doublingBody: The demonstration starts with 123456789 already on the abacus. Three doubles reach 246913578, 493827156 and 987654312; add nine to finish at 987654321. Pause, continue or show one step. In practice, set the starting number yourself, then check each target. Checks include the taught bead representation and manual carries, not only the total. Leaving restores your free-play abacus.
seo.homeDescription: Explore a Chinese abacus with two upper and five lower beads per rod. Read place values and practise four games on iPhone, iPad, Mac and visionOS.
seo.helpTitle: SuanCraft Help — Abacus Controls, Numbers & Four Games
seo.helpDescription: Learn how to move beads, read place values, carry manually and practise four abacus games with demonstrations and optional system narration.
game.doubling.summary: Double 123456789 three times, then add nine for a reversed finish.
game.carousel.summary: Keep adding 142857 and follow the repeating digits to 999999.
game.hundredReturn.summary: Subtract consecutive numbers and bring the abacus back to zero.
game.equivalent.summary: Discover three bead arrangements that represent the same number.
help.carouselBody: Start at 142857 and add 142857 six times to reach 999999. Each round shows both addends and the sum, for example 285714 + 142857 = 428571. Practise the same sequence and handle carries yourself.
help.hundredReturnBody: Start at 5050 and subtract 1, 2 and so on through 100 to finish at zero. You can also choose 10 or 20 steps; each shorter game starts at the corresponding sum. Demonstrations show the required bead changes and borrowing.
help.equivalentBody: Represent ten in three ways: two upper beads on the ones rod; one upper bead and five lower beads; then one lower bead on the tens rod. Checks compare the taught bead arrangement, not only the total.
faq.shape.question: Which kind of abacus is this?
faq.shape.answer: A Chinese abacus with two upper and five lower beads per rod. Use nine rods or switch to enlarged one-rod practice.
faq.carry.question: Are carries automatic?
faq.carry.answer: No. You move beads and carry or borrow manually. The displayed total is calculated from the actual bead positions and place values.
faq.progress.question: Is progress saved?
faq.progress.answer: Bead positions and game progress last for the current window session. The narration preference is stored locally.
faq.voice.question: How does narration work?
faq.voice.answer: Optional system text-to-speech speaks key arithmetic cues using installed voices. Explanations remain on screen.
